title: Syllable Counter
description: Count syllables in any text with a real vowel-group heuristic — totals, averages and a per-word breakdown table.
howto: Paste your text (a poem, lyrics or a paragraph).
Read total syllables, word count and average syllables per word instantly.
Check the per-word table to see the syllable count of each word.

faqs.a: A standard heuristic: each group of vowels (a, e, i, o, u, y) counts as one syllable, a silent trailing "e" is dropped, and every word gets at least one syllable.
No heuristic is perfect for English — it is about 95%+ accurate on normal prose. Check the per-word table for any word you doubt.

faqs.q: Can I use it for haiku?
faqs.a: Yes. The total-syllable readout makes it easy to check the 5-7-5 pattern line by line.
